_meta.purpose: Map NinjaTrader account-name prefixes to (firm, phase) so the app can open on the user's real accounts with the right rules preselected.
_meta.why_data_not_code: Adding a firm must never require editing logic. Users can also add their own patterns here without a rebuild.
_meta.limits: A name identifies at most the firm and the phase. Account SIZE and VARIANT are not derivable from it, so a match preselects the firm and phase only and the user still picks size and variant. Treat every match as a convenience, never as truth.
_meta.matching: case-insensitive prefix match, longest pattern wins

patterns.note: Apex uses the same name shape for evaluation and PA; phase is not derivable. NOTE: Apex prohibits automated strategies in every phase.
